Fluffy White Cooked Frosting
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 6, 2009 - 12:31am

Ingredients




3 egg whites
6 tablespoons light corn syrup
3/4 cup sugar
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/8 teaspoon vanilla

Preparation

1 In double boiler, combine first 5 ingredients. Cook over rapidly boiling water. Beat constantly with mixer (about 4 minutes until it peaks). Remove from heat. Add vanilla; beat 2 more minutes. Cool slightly and frost cake.
